描述_EN: plate made of porcelain in an octagonal shape. the original underglaze blue decoration consists of a border of flowers around the rim and a rocky river-scene with buildings and a boat in the middle. to this have been added in enamel colours three figures in the boat, a bird, a large butterfly, a pagoda, and flowers in the intervals of the landscape, a border of gilt cresting surrounding it, and a wavy stem with flowers and floliage between the cresting and the outer border of the rim.
描述_ZN: 八角形的瓷板。 原来的釉下蓝装饰包括边缘的花边和中间有建筑物和船的岩石河景。 在此基础上，用珐琅彩添加了船中的三个人物，一只鸟，一只大蝴蝶，一座宝塔，以及山水间的花朵，周围有一圈鎏金的纹饰，在纹饰和边框的外缘之间有一圈波浪形的花茎。
